import os,json,subprocess,tempfile
from pathlib import Path
base=Path(tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix='native-cumulative-',dir='.cache')).resolve()
common=['--binary',os.environ['SWARM_STATUS_CONTRACT_BINARY'],'--profile',os.environ['SWARM_STATUS_CONTRACT_PROFILE']]
command=['python3','tests/rust_native_cumulative_publication.py',*common,'--output',str(base/'publication'),'--rollback-sdk',os.environ['SWARM_CUMULATIVE_ROLLBACK_SDK']]
if os.environ.get('SWARM_CUMULATIVE_BASELINE_FROM'):command.extend(['--baseline-from',os.environ['SWARM_CUMULATIVE_BASELINE_FROM']])
subprocess.run(command,check=True)
r=json.loads((base/'publication/result.json').read_bytes());assert r['status']=='PASS' and r['cumulative_publication'] and not r['paid_provider'] and len(r['checks'])==9
subprocess.run(['python3','tests/rust_native_cumulative_policies.py',*common,'--output',str(base/'policies'),'--published-from',str(base/'publication'),'--ensure-review-capacity'],check=True)
s=json.loads((base/'policies/result.json').read_bytes());assert s['status']=='PASS' and len(s['checks'])==2 and s['work_unchanged'] and s['settings_values_restored'] and s['settings_history_preserved']
command=['python3','tests/rust_post_publication_worker.py',*common,'--output',str(base/'dependent'),'--published-from',str(base/'publication'),'--ensure-review-capacity']
if os.environ.get('SWARM_CUMULATIVE_BASELINE_FROM'):command.extend(['--native-from',os.environ['SWARM_CUMULATIVE_BASELINE_FROM']])
subprocess.run(command,check=True)
t=json.loads((base/'dependent/result.json').read_bytes());assert t['status']=='PASS' and t['cumulative_publication'] and t['accepted_task_count']==2 and len(t['checks'])==4 and t['candidate_commit']==r['candidate_commit'] and not t['mission_accepted']
print('NATIVE_CUMULATIVE_RECIPE_VERIFIED '+str(base))
